title: Toilet Paper Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass Freestanding European Style | Golden Yellow | Best Sellers Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Need a toilet paper holder where wall space is limited? This freestanding toilet paper stand adds convenient roll storage right beside the toilet, with European styling for quick, easy roll changes in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality.

Highlights:
- Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Change rolls fast: European-style hook makes swapping a roll quick and easy
- Coordinate your space: part of the Best Sellers Collection for a cohesive look with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Built for lasting use: crafted from solid brass and offered in multiple designer finish options

Specs & Details:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.75 in x 26 in x 5.5 in
- Shipping weight: 6 lb
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Assembly: Assembled in the USA
